description.narrative: This investment consolidates Australia's regional funding assistance to improve health outcomes in the Pacific. Support is provided through key multilateral and regional partners, including the Pacific Community’s Public Health Division, the Royal Australasian College of Surgeons, Fiji National University’s College of Medicine, Nursing and Health Sciences and the United Nations Children's Fund. Activities under this investment support: specialised clinical services; research; health systems strengthening; non-communicable disease prevention and control; and the training of healthcare workers.
